question: what is the return rate of P105 and why?
sql:
SELECT 
    p.product_code,
    c.customer,
    strftime('%m', f.month) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.transaction_type = 'Sale' THEN f.net_sales_aed ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_sale,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.transaction_type = 'Return' THEN f.net_sales_aed ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_return,
    -SUM(CASE WHEN f.transaction_type = 'Return' THEN f.net_sales_aed ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN f.transaction_type = 'Sale' THEN f.net_sales_aed ELSE 0 END) AS return_rate
FROM 
    fact_sales f
JOIN 
    dim_product p ON f.product_code = p.product_code
JOIN 
    dim_customer c ON f.customer = c.customer
WHERE 
    p.product_code = 'P105'
GROUP BY 
    p.product_code, c.customer, strftime('%m', f.month)
ORDER BY 
    return_rate DESC
LIMIT 
    10;

question: Can we see the categories and subcategories with their details?
sql:
SELECT 
    p.category, 
    p.sub_category, 
    SUM(fs.net_sales_aed) AS total_sales_aed, 
    SUM(fs.quantity) AS units_sold, 
    ROUND(SUM(fs.gross_profit_aed) * 100.0 / SUM(fs.net_sales_aed), 2) AS gross_margin_percent
FROM 
    fact_sales fs
JOIN 
    dim_product p ON fs.product_code = p.product_code
GROUP BY 
    p.category, p.sub_category
ORDER BY 
    total_sales_aed DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.category, 
    p.sub_category, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN fs.transaction_type = 'Sale' THEN fs.net_sales_aed ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_aed_sale, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN fs.transaction_type = 'Return' THEN fs.net_sales_aed ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_aed_return, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN fs.transaction_type = 'Sale' THEN fs.net_sales_aed ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN fs.transaction_type = 'Return' THEN fs.net_sales_aed ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_aed_net, 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN fs.transaction_type = 'Return' THEN fs.net_sales_aed ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN fs.transaction_type = 'Sale' THEN fs.net_sales_aed ELSE 0 END)) AS return_rate_percent
FROM 
    fact_sales fs
JOIN 
    dim_product p ON fs.product_code = p.product_code
WHERE 
    p.product_code = 'P105' AND p.category = 'Home Care'
GROUP BY 
    p.category, p.sub_category
ORDER BY 
    return_rate_percent DESC
LIMIT 1;
